node.title: Conjecture-F absolute-exponent global packing
node.statement: For every typed descriptor emitted by f_prize_consumer_flat_scope, after the proved spread/rank-defect split, strict descent, paid first owners, and support-lattice memoization, the complete first-owner sum of the exact spread-leaf bounds binom(n_leaf,r_leaf)/binom(j_leaf,r_leaf) is at most n^B_F for one absolute exponent independent of the initial dimension and descent path. The scope compiler must prove the quantitative dimension regime; merely assuming r<j is not enough.
node.attack_surface: find a telescoping potential that absorbs dimension-dependent spread numerators through divisor depth and quotient scale while preserving first ownership
node.falsifier: proper-flat instances whose exact owner-disjoint spread-leaf sum exceeds every fixed power of n
